name: design-proposal-kit
description: Turn a client brief into a design proposal PDF: prompt bundles for section mockups, stacking, and an A4 render.

scripts.example: npm run example:images && npm run example:stack && npm run example:pdf
scripts.example:stack: for d in warm-and-playful bright-and-photographic bold-and-colourful; do ./scripts/stack-direction.sh -c 76 example/bundles/$d || exit 1; done
